content.comment_body: Hello, I have installed around 14 or 15 [product_name] CPUs on a site. Two of these are configured with [product_name] Web Editor to display alarms. However, one of them repeatedly has connection issues—after some time, I cannot access its page, receiving the message 'this site can't be reached, the connection was reset.' If I restart the device physically, it works again but the issue returns after one or two days. I can't figure out the difference compared to the other units, as both are set up with [product_name] Web Editor and used similarly. I'm considering replacing the CPU but I'm unsure if that would resolve the problem. Thank you for your suggestions.
Please provide the full [article_no] and firmware [version_no] of your [product_name].

analysis.insight_summary: A user is experiencing ongoing connectivity problems with one out of several installed [product_name] controllers when using the [product_name] Web Editor. This particular device regularly becomes inaccessible over the web after a day or two and only resumes operation after a manual restart. The other similar devices do not have this issue, causing uncertainty about the cause. The situation highlights concerns about the reliability of remote web access for these devices.
analysis.user_expectations: The user wants uninterrupted, reliable access to the web interface of all [product_name] controllers without needing frequent manual restarts. Consistent operation across all installed units is expected.
